source_provenance.citation: Zhang et al., Overcoming the fill-factor limit of organic solar cells, Nature Photonics (2026)
source_provenance.project_use: method precedent for TDCF and bias-dependent PL as field-dependent free-charge-generation discriminators; not evidence for D18/PY-IT/eC9

primary_measurement.freeze_rule: instrument-safe values and a common prebias grid must be frozen before arm identities are unblinded

estimators.field_loss: L_arm=max_V[1-r_arm(V)] over the preregistered evaluation set

symbols.eta_FC: free-charge-generation efficiency from TDCF with absorbed-photon normalization; dimensionless
symbols.V_ref: frozen reference bias, normally the least field-limited point in the common grid; V
symbols.L: worst field-dependent generation loss over evaluation grid; dimensionless
symbols.D: arm field-loss penalty relative to contemporaneous B0 in same independent lot; dimensionless

decision_rule.fail_closed: No B1/B2 useful-work PASS is allowed while the field-generation margin is null or was selected after arm unblinding.
decision_rule.useful_work_gate: An interface arm that improves DeltaVnr/Voc but has field-generation penalty beyond the frozen margin and no stabilized FF/Pmax improvement is mechanism science, not useful-work validation.

serious_conventional_explanations: mobility/recombination/contact differences can lower FF without field-dependent generation
absorption/morphology/thickness differences can alter apparent generation or PL without an Ex-to-CT field-sensitivity change
heating, injection history, fluence dependence, or timing differences can bias TDCF/PL comparisons
falsification: The EPC/interface useful-work interpretation is narrowed if lower DeltaVnr is not accompanied by field-robust charge generation and stabilized electrical output across independent lots.
